name: @pipeworx/mcp-foodish

tools.name: random
tools.description: Return a random food dish image URL from the Foodish API, drawn from any category (biryani, burger, pizza, pasta, dessert, etc.).

tools.name: random_by_category
tools.description: Return a random food image URL for a specific category; valid categories: biryani, burger, butter-chicken, dessert, dosa, idly, pasta, pizza, rice, samosa.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-foodish forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the foodish pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
